claims: Cosine addition gives cos(2π f1 t) + cos(2π f2 t) = 2 cos(π (f2−f1)t) cos(π (f1+f2)t). Absolute envelope maxima repeat every 1/|f2−f1| seconds. Generated tones are mixed mono, not binaural beats.

Schematic carrier curves illustrate signed addition with slowed relative alignment. They do not depict calibrated 220 Hz motion. The listening-window circle follows the actual absolute envelope in real seconds.
limitations: Numerical checks complement the stated derivation; idealizations are explicit.
